name: Theramore Spies
summary: In Dustwallow, Horde and Alliance keep an uneasy truce, though skirmishes and covert deeds continue. Nazeer Bloodpike wants Alliance infiltrators east of Brackenwall Village hunted down and slain.

sections.title: Spies East of the Village
sections.body:
Alliance spies watch Brackenwall Village from the islands to its east. They send word of Horde movements back to Theramore.

Nazeer Bloodpike, the village spymaster, sends you to find and kill them. Their superiors must know such spies are unwelcome.

faq.q: Who orders the death of the Theramore infiltrators?
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike, the spymaster in Brackenwall Village, orders the infiltrators killed.
The infiltrators hide on the islands east of Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: Why are the spies watching Brackenwall Village?
aliases: why are humans spying on brackenwall
faq.answer: The spies watch Brackenwall Village and send word of Horde movements back to Theramore.

faq.q: What comes after dealing with the spies?
aliases: what quest comes after theramore spies
faq.answer: The next step is The Theramore Docks.
